notes: A dependency shipped as compiled CommonJS: Babel output (interop/extends/objectWithoutProperties helpers, `exports.x =`, `Object.keys(...).forEach` re-exports), tsc output (inline `__importDefault`, `exports.default =`), esbuild output (`__export(ns, { x: () => x })` + `module.exports = __toCommonJS(ns)`), minified esbuild output whose helpers have lost their names (`module.exports = ee(oe)` evaluated to an `__esModule` object whose members are the imports, its default re-exported from a sibling `__toESM(require(...))`), and a rollup UMD build whose factory receives `exports` and `require(...)`d dependencies as parameters; all analyzed from source through the CommonJS export model. `umd-join` is a UMD wrapper whose parameterless factory `return` becomes `module.exports` and whose body reads `arguments` through `[].slice.call`. `badge.js` also `require`s the installed `hasown` and `object.entries` (pure packages), whose `module.exports` functions run on the known props. `cjs-statics` is a pre-class constructor exposed as `module.exports = Registry` that also hangs itself and `defaultLimit` off the function (`Registry.Registry = Registry`, `module.exports.defaultLimit = 10`), so `import { Registry, defaultLimit }` resolves to those statics and its prototype methods run on the instance.
